RUN /bin/sh -c rm -f /usr/bin/pebble     && apt-get update && apt-get -y upgrade     && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends        ca-certificates perl libyaml-0-2 zlib1g libstdc++6     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*     && groupadd --gid 10001 kong     && useradd --uid 10001 --gid 10001 --home-dir /usr/local/kong kong # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c mkdir -p /usr/local/kong /etc/kong     && chown -R kong:kong /usr/local/kong     && ln -s /usr/local/openresty/luajit/bin/luajit /usr/local/bin/luajit     && ln -s /usr/local/openresty/nginx/sbin/nginx /usr/local/bin/nginx     && ln -s /usr/local/openresty/bin/resty /usr/local/bin/resty # buildkit
ENV KONG_DATABASE=off KONG_ADMIN_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:8001 KONG_NGINX_WORKER_PROCESSES=2 KONG_ANONYMOUS_REPORTS=off KONG_ADMIN_GUI_LISTEN=off
HEALTHCHECK {Test:[CMD-SHELL kong-health] Interval:30s Timeout:10s StartPeriod:30s StartInterval:0s Retries:0}

RUN /bin/sh -c sed -i -e 's#^mozilla/emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_C3.crt#!mozilla/emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_C3.crt#' -e 's#^mozilla/emSign_Root_CA_-_C1.crt#!mozilla/emSign_Root_CA_-_C1.crt#' /etc/ca-certificates.conf  && update-ca-certificates --fresh >/dev/null  && ! grep -q 'emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_C3\|emSign_Root_CA_-_C1' /etc/ca-certificates.conf.d 2>/dev/null;     test ! -e /etc/ssl/certs/emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_C3.pem && test ! -e /etc/ssl/certs/emSign_Root_CA_-_C1.pem # buildkit
